hooks.name: doc-sync
hooks.description: After each spec task finishes, keep README.md and KIRO_USAGE.md in step with what actually changed.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Check the changes made in this task (git diff and git status). If, and only if, user-visible behaviour, commands, dependencies, the privacy story, or Kiro configuration under .kiro/ changed, update README.md (how to run, how to test, privacy statement, Pre-existing work with every new dependency and its licence) and KIRO_USAGE.md (which Kiro feature was used and what it did in this task). Rules: write only what actually happened, never invent numbers, users or results, write 'not measured' if a number is unknown, use plain sentences, and never use the em dash character (U+2014). If nothing relevant changed, reply 'doc-sync: no doc changes needed' and edit nothing.
